MAJOR REMODELS

Reimagine Your Space

Whether you’re opening up your kitchen, updating a bathroom, or giving your entire home a fresh new feel, Wheatland Construction brings beauty and functionality together. We specialize in major remodeling projects starting at $50,000 — work that requires real expertise, detailed planning, and trades coordination we handle in-house.

We respect your time, budget, and space — keeping you informed throughout the process and delivering results that genuinely enhance your daily life.

Starting at $50,000

We specialize in larger-scope remodels that require deep experience and careful planning. Quality over speed, every time.
